---
title: "Combined UMAP + VAE Permutation Visualization"
subtitle: "Null distributions, p-value heatmap, and summary boxplot across methods and thresholds"
---

## Overview

Combine permutation test results from UMAP and VAE lite analyses, computing empirical p-values and visualizing null distributions, p-value heatmaps, and summary boxplots across both methods and thresholds 7 and 8.

## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, install = FALSE)
conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

Load permutation and observed DPS from both methods and both thresholds, strip method-specific column prefixes to create generic dimension pair labels, and bind into combined tibbles.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

methods <- list(
  UMAP = list(
    perm_template = \(th) here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/permutation_dps_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    obs_template  = \(th) here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/dps_results_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    col_prefix    = "umap_"
  ),
  VAE = list(
    perm_template = \(th) here(glue("VAE/lite/permutation/output/permutation_dps_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    obs_template  = \(th) here(glue("VAE/lite/DPS/output/dps_results_threshold_{th}.rds")),
    col_prefix    = "vae_"
  )
)

thresholds <- c(8, 7)

# Load all data into a nested list: data[[method]][[threshold]]
data_all <- map(names(methods), \(method) {
  info <- methods[[method]]
  map(thresholds, \(th) {
    perm <- read_rds(info$perm_template(th)) |>
      mutate(
        method = method,
        threshold = th,
        method_threshold = glue("{method} Thr {th}"),
        dim_pair_label = glue(
          "dim_{str_remove(dimx, paste0('^', info$col_prefix))} vs dim_{str_remove(dimy, paste0('^', info$col_prefix))}"
        )
      )
    obs <- read_rds(info$obs_template(th)) |>
      mutate(
        method = method,
        threshold = th,
        method_threshold = glue("{method} Thr {th}"),
        dim_pair_label = glue(
          "dim_{str_remove(dimx, paste0('^', info$col_prefix))} vs dim_{str_remove(dimy, paste0('^', info$col_prefix))}"
        )
      )
    list(perm_dps = perm, obs_dps = obs)
  }) |>
    set_names(thresholds)
}) |>
  set_names(names(methods))

# Bind into combined tibbles
perm_all <- map(names(data_all), \(method) {
  map(data_all[[method]], \(td) td$perm_dps) |> list_rbind()
}) |> list_rbind()

obs_all <- map(names(data_all), \(method) {
  map(data_all[[method]], \(td) td$obs_dps) |> list_rbind()
}) |> list_rbind()

message(glue("Permutation rows: {nrow(perm_all)}, Observed rows: {nrow(obs_all)}"))
```

## Compute Empirical P-values

p = (number of permutations with DPS >= observed) / N_permutations, computed per method-threshold-dimension pair.

```{r}
#| label: compute-pvalues

pvalues_all <- map(names(data_all), \(method) {
  map(names(data_all[[method]]), \(th_chr) {
    td <- data_all[[method]][[th_chr]]

    td$obs_dps |>
      select(dimx, dimy, path2d_dps, method, threshold, method_threshold, dim_pair_label) |>
      rename(observed = path2d_dps) |>
      left_join(
        td$perm_dps |> select(perm_id, dimx, dimy, path2d_dps),
        by = c("dimx", "dimy"),
        relationship = "many-to-many"
      ) |>
      summarise(
        observed = first(observed),
        n_perm_gte = sum(path2d_dps >= observed, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_permutations = n(),
        p_value = n_perm_gte / n_permutations,
        perm_mean = mean(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
        perm_sd = sd(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
        method = first(method),
        threshold = first(threshold),
        method_threshold = first(method_threshold),
        dim_pair_label = first(dim_pair_label),
        .by = c(dimx, dimy)
      )
  }) |> list_rbind()
}) |> list_rbind()

message(glue("P-values computed: {nrow(pvalues_all)} rows ({length(unique(pvalues_all$method_threshold))} method-threshold combos x {nrow(pvalues_all) / length(unique(pvalues_all$method_threshold))} dim pairs)"))
```

## P-value Summary

```{r}
#| label: pvalue-summary

pvalue_summary <- pvalues_all |>
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    n_significant = sum(p_value < 0.05),
    prop_significant = n_significant / n_pairs,
    mean_pvalue = mean(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_pvalue = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = method_threshold
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(n_pairs, n_significant), \(x) round(x, 3)))

pvalue_summary
```

## Plot 1: Aggregate Null Distribution Histograms

Four-panel histogram showing the aggregate null distribution (mean DPS across dimension pairs per permutation) for each method-threshold combination, with observed mean as red dashed line.

```{r}
#| label: fig-null-distribution
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

# Aggregate permuted DPS: mean across dim pairs per permutation
perm_agg <- perm_all |>
  summarise(
    mean_dps = mean(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(perm_id, method, threshold, method_threshold)
  )

# Aggregate observed DPS: mean across dim pairs
obs_agg <- obs_all |>
  summarise(
    mean_dps = mean(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(method, threshold, method_threshold)
  )

# Compute aggregate p-values for annotation
agg_pvalues <- perm_agg |>
  left_join(obs_agg, by = c("method", "threshold", "method_threshold"), suffix = c("_perm", "_obs")) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = sum(mean_dps_perm >= mean_dps_obs, na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    .by = c(method, threshold, method_threshold)
  ) |>
  mutate(label = glue("p = {sprintf('%.3f', p_value)}"))

plot_null_hist <- ggplot(perm_agg, aes(x = mean_dps)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "gray70", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(
    data = obs_agg,
    aes(xintercept = mean_dps),
    color = "red", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = agg_pvalues,
    aes(label = label),
    x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4, color = "red", fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ method_threshold, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Aggregate Null Distribution: Mean Path2D DPS Across Dim Pairs",
    subtitle = "Red dashed line = observed mean; gray = permuted null",
    x = "Mean Path2D DPS",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_null_hist
```

## Plot 2: P-value Heatmap

Dimension pairs (rows) x method-threshold combinations (columns), with red fill for significant p-values.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pvalue-heatmap
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

plot_pvalue_heatmap <- ggplot(
  pvalues_all,
  aes(x = method_threshold, y = dim_pair_label, fill = p_value)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.3f", p_value),
      color = p_value < 0.05
    ),
    size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#b2182b", mid = "#fddbc7", high = "white",
    midpoint = 0.05, limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "p-value"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Empirical P-values: Observed vs Permuted Path2D DPS",
    subtitle = "Red = significant (p < 0.05); white = non-significant",
    x = "Method / Threshold",
    y = "Dimension Pair"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

plot_pvalue_heatmap
```

## Plot 3: Summary Boxplot

Permuted aggregate DPS distributions as boxplots with observed mean as red diamond, across all four method-threshold combinations.

```{r}
#| label: fig-summary-boxplot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

plot_summary_boxplot <- ggplot(
  perm_agg,
  aes(x = method_threshold, y = mean_dps)
) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = obs_agg,
    aes(x = method_threshold, y = mean_dps),
    color = "red", size = 5, shape = 18
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permuted Path2D DPS vs Observed",
    subtitle = "Boxplots = permuted null (mean across dim pairs); red diamond = observed",
    x = "Method / Threshold",
    y = "Mean Path2D DPS Across Dim Pairs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_summary_boxplot
```

## Save Outputs

Save all three plots as PNG and RDS, plus the combined p-values tibble.

```{r}
#| label: save-outputs

output_dir <- here("VAE_UMAP_comb/output")
fs::dir_create(output_dir)

plots <- list(
  fig_perm_null_hist = list(plot = plot_null_hist, w = 12, h = 8),
  fig_perm_pvalue_heatmap = list(plot = plot_pvalue_heatmap, w = 10, h = 8),
  fig_perm_summary_boxplot = list(plot = plot_summary_boxplot, w = 10, h = 6)
)

iwalk(plots, \(spec, nm) {
  ggsave(
    here(output_dir, glue("{nm}.png")),
    spec$plot, width = spec$w, height = spec$h, dpi = 300,
    bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
  )
  write_rds(spec$plot, here(output_dir, glue("{nm}.rds")))
})

write_rds(pvalues_all, here(output_dir, "pvalues_all.rds"))
message("Saved all combined permutation visualization outputs")
```
